basic_atk.name: Order: Flare Propulsion
basic_atk.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to {atk_scaling}% of SAM's ATK to one designated enemy.

enhanced_basic_atk.name: Fyrefly Type-IV: Pyrogenic Decimation
enhanced_basic_atk.description: Restores HP by an amount equal to 20% of this unit's Max HP. Deals Fire DMG equal to {atk_scaling}% of SAM's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Order: Aerial Bombardment
skill.description: Consumes HP equal to 40% of this unit's Max HP and regenerates a fixed amount of Energy equal to {energy_scaling}% of this unit's Max Energy. Deals Fire DMG equal to {atk_scaling}% of SAM's ATK to a single target enemy. If the current HP is not sufficient, reduces SAM's HP to 1 when using this Skill. Advances this unit's next Action by 25%.

enhanced_skill.name: Fyrefly Type-IV: Deathstar Overload
enhanced_skill.description: Restores HP by an amount equal to 25% of this unit's Max HP. Applies Fire Weakness to a single target enemy, lasting for 2 turn(s). Deals Fire DMG equal to (0.2 x Break Effect + {scaling_1}%) of SAM's ATK to this target. At the same time, deals Fire DMG equal to (0.1 x Break Effect + {scaling_2}%) of SAM's ATK to adjacent targets. The Break Effect taken into the calculation is capped at 360%.

ultimate.name: Fyrefly Type-IV: Complete Combustion
ultimate.description: Enters the Complete Combustion state, advances this unit's Action by 100%, and gains Enhanced Basic ATK and Enhanced Skill. While in Complete Combustion, increases SPD by {spd_scaling}, and when using the Enhanced Basic ATK or Enhanced Skill, increases this unit's Weakness Break Efficiency by 50% and the Break DMG dealt by SAM to the enemy targets by {dmg_bonus}%, lasting until this current attack ends. A countdown timer for the Complete Combustion state appears on the Action Order. When the countdown timer's turn starts, SAM exits the Complete Combustion state. The countdown timer has a fixed SPD of 70. SAM cannot use Ultimate while in Complete Combustion.

talent.name: Chrysalid Pyronexus
talent.description: The lower the HP, the less DMG received. When HP is 20% or lower, the DMG Reduction reaches its maximum effect, reducing up to {dmg_reduction}%. During the Complete Combustion, the DMG Reduction remains at its maximum effect, and the Effect RES increases by {eff_res_scaling}%. If Energy is lower than 50% when the battle starts, regenerates Energy to 50%. Once Energy is regenerated to its maximum, dispels all debuffs on this unit.

technique.name: Order: Meteoric Incineration
technique.description: Leaps into the air and moves about freely for 5 seconds, which can be ended early by launching a plunging attack. When the duration ends, plunges and immediately attacks all enemies within a set area. At the start of each wave, applies a Fire Weakness to all enemies, lasting for 2 turn(s). Then, deals Fire DMG equal to 200% of SAM's ATK to all enemies.

a2.name: Module Alpha: Antilag Outburst
a2.description: During the Complete Combustion, attacking enemies that have no Fire Weakness can also reduce their Toughness, with the effect being equivalent to 55% of the original Toughness Reduction from abilities.

a4.name: Module Beta: Autoreactive Armor
a4.description: When SAM is in Complete Combustion with a Break Effect that is equal to or greater than 200%/360%, attacking a Weakness-Broken enemy target will convert the Toughness Reduction of this attack into 1 instance of 35%/50% Super Break DMG.

a6.name: Module Gamma: Core Overload
a6.description: For every 10 point(s) of SAM's ATK that exceeds 1800, increases this unit's Break Effect by 0.8%.

Eidolons.name: In Reddened Chrysalis, I Once Rest
Eidolons.description: When using the Enhanced Skill, ignores 15% of the target's DEF. The Enhanced Skill does not consume Skill Points.

Eidolons.name: From Shattered Sky, I Free Fall
Eidolons.description: While in Complete Combustion, using the Enhanced Basic ATK or the Enhanced Skill to defeat an enemy target or to Break their Weakness allows SAM to immediately gain 1 extra turn. This effect can only trigger 1 time per turn, and the trigger count resets at the start of SAM's turn.

Eidolons.name: Amidst Silenced Stars, I Deep Sleep
Eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

Eidolons.name: Upon Lighted Fyrefly, I Soon Gaze
Eidolons.description: While in Complete Combustion, increases SAM's Effect RES by 50%.

Eidolons.name: From Undreamt Night, I Thence Shine
Eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

Eidolons.name: In Finalized Morrow, I Full Bloom
Eidolons.description: While in Complete Combustion, increases SAM's Fire RES PEN by 20%. When using the Enhanced Basic ATK or Enhanced Skill, increases Weakness Break Efficiency by 50%.

basic_atk.name: Swing Dance Ettiquette
basic_atk.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {atk_scaling}% of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Halftime to Make It Rain
skill.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {atk_scaling}% of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy target and additionally deals DMG for 4 times, with each time dealing Imaginary DMG equal to {atk_scaling}% of the Trailblazer's ATK to a random enemy.

ultimate.name: All-Out Footlight Parade
ultimate.description: Grants all allies the Backup Dancer effect, lasting for 3 turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Trailblazer's every turn. Allies with the Backup Dancer effect have their Break Effect increased by 33%. And when they attack enemy targets that are in the Weakness Broken state, the Toughness Reduction of the attack will be converted into 1 instance of Super Break DMG.

talent.name: Full-on Aerial Dance
talent.description: The Trailblazer immediately regenerates {energy} Energy when an enemy target's Weakness is Broken.

technique.name: Now! I'm the Band!
technique.description: After the Technique is used, at the start of the next battle, all allies' Break Effect increases by 30%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

a2.name: Dance With the One
a2.description: When the number of enemy targets on the field is 5 (or more)/4/3/2/1, the Super Break DMG triggered by the Backup Dancer effect increases by 20%/30%/40%/50%/60%.

a4.name: Shuffle Along
a4.description: When using Skill, additionally increases the Toughness Reduction of the first instance of DMG by 100%

a6.name: Hat of the Theater
a6.description: After ally targets break weakness, additionally delays the action of the enemy target by 30%.

Eidolons.name: Best Seat in the House
Eidolons.description: After using Skill for the first time, immediately recovers 1 Skill Point(s).

Eidolons.name: Jailbreaking Rainbowwalk
Eidolons.description: When the battle starts, the Trailblazer's Energy Regerenation Rate increases by 25%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

Eidolons.name: Sanatorium for Rest Notes
Eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

Eidolons.name: Dove in Tophat
Eidolons.description: While the Trailblazer is on the field, increases the Break Effect of all teammates (excluding the Trailblazer), by an amount equal to 15% of the Trailblazer's Break Effect.

Eidolons.name: Poem Favors Rhythms of Old
Eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

Eidolons.name: Tomorrow, Rest in Spotlight
Eidolons.description: The number of additional DMG applications by the Skill increases by 2.

basic_atk.name: Radiant Streak
basic_atk.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to {atk_scaling}% of Fugue's ATK to one designated enemy.

enhanced_basic_atk.name: Fiery Caress
enhanced_basic_atk.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to {atk_scaling_1}% of Fugue's ATK to one designated enemy and Fire DMG equal to {atk_scaling_2}% of Fugues's ATK to adjacent targets.

skill.name: Virtue Beckons Bliss
skill.description:
Grants one designated ally 'Foxian Prayer'. Enters the 'Torrid Scorch' state, lasting for 3 turn(s). The duration decreases by 1 at the start of Fugue's every turn. 'Foxian Prayer' only takes effect on the most recent target of Fugue's Skill.
The ally target with 'Foxian Prayer' increases their Break Effeect by {Break_Effect_bonus}% and can also reduce Toughness even when attacing enemies that don't have the corresponding Weakness Type.
While in the 'Torrid Scorch state, Fugue enhances her Basic ATK. Every time an ally target with 'Foxian Prayer' attacks, Fugue has a 100% base chance to reduce the attacked enemy target's DEF by {DEF_reduction}%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

ultimate.name: Solar Splendor Shines Upon All
ultimate.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to {atk_scaling}% of Fugue's ATK to all enemies. This attack ignores Weakness Type to reduce all enemies' Toughness. And when breaking Weakness, triggers the Fire Weakness Break effect.

talent.name: Fortune Follows Where Virtue Spreads
talent.description:
While Fugue is on the field, enemy targets will get additionally aflicted with 'Cloudflame Luster' equal to 40% of their Max Toughness. When the initial Toughness is reduced to 0, 'Cloudflame Luster' can continue to be reduced. When 'Cloudflame Luster' is reduced to 0, the enemy will receive Weakness Break DMG again.
While Fugue is on the field and after allies attack Weakness Broken enemy targets, converts the Toughness Reduction of this attack into 1 instance of 100% Super Break DMG.

technique.name: Percipient Shine
technique.description:
After using Technique, inflicts Daze on enemies within a certain area, lasting for 10 second(s). While Dazed, enemies will not actively attack ally targets.
After entering battle via actively attacking Dazed enemies, Fugue's action advances by 40%, with a 100% base chance to inflict each enemy target with the same DEF Reduction state as that applied by Fugue's Skill, lasting for 2 turn(s).

a2.name: Smoldering
a2.description: When an enemy with Foxian Prayer has their Weakness Broken, the breaking ally regenerates {energy} Energy.

a4.name: Combustion
a4.description: When Fugue uses her Skill, if the target enemy already has Foxian Prayer, additionally deals Break DMG equal to 100% of Fugue's ATK to the target.

a6.name: Conflagration
a6.description: When Fugue uses her Ultimate, all allies ignore {res_pen}% of the target enemy's Fire RES for 2 turn(s).

Eidolons.name: Overture of Calamity's Embers
Eidolons.description: Increases the duration of Foxian Prayer by 1 turn. When the wearer uses the Enhanced Basic ATK, additionally applies Foxian Prayer to adjacent targets.

Eidolons.name: Cadenza of Creaking Bones
Eidolons.description: When any ally breaks an enemy's Weakness, Fugue regenerates 5 Energy.

Eidolons.name: Interlude of Smoldering Ash
Eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

Eidolons.name: Requiem of Ardent Souls
Eidolons.description: When the Enhanced Basic ATK is used, additionally regenerates 10 Energy for Fugue.

Eidolons.name: Ballad of Raging Blazes
Eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

Eidolons.name: Finale of Eternal Flames
Eidolons.description: Foxian Prayer additionally increases the enemy's Super Break DMG taken by 20%.

basic_atk.name: Spark
basic_atk.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to {atk_scaling}% of The Dahlia's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Ember's Waltz
skill.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to {atk_scaling}% of The Dahlia's ATK to one designated enemy. If the enemy is Weakness Broken, additionally deals Break DMG equal to {break_scaling}% of The Dahlia's ATK.

ultimate.name: Crimson Finale
ultimate.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to {atk_scaling}% of The Dahlia's ATK to all enemies. All enemies' Fire RES is reduced by {fire_res_reduction}% for {duration} turn(s). Increases all allies' Break Effect by {break_effect_bonus}% for {duration} turn(s).

talent.name: Ashen Bloom
talent.description: When any ally attacks an enemy that is Weakness Broken, The Dahlia deals additional Fire DMG equal to {proc_scaling}% of her ATK to that enemy. This effect can trigger once per attack.

technique.name: Opening Act
technique.description: At the start of battle, reduces all enemies' Fire RES by 20% for 2 turn(s) and increases all allies' Break Effect by 20% for 2 turn(s).

a2.name: Smoldering Aria
a2.description: When The Dahlia's Break Effect is 150% or higher, her Talent's additional Fire DMG increases by 50%.

a4.name: Blazing Cadence
a4.description: When The Dahlia uses her Skill on a Weakness Broken enemy, regenerates 10 Energy.

a6.name: Infernal Crescendo
a6.description: After The Dahlia uses her Ultimate, all allies' Fire DMG increases by 20% for 2 turn(s).

Eidolons.name: Prelude of Scorched Earth
Eidolons.description: When The Dahlia uses her Skill, if the target is Weakness Broken, additionally reduces the target's DEF by 15% for 2 turn(s).

Eidolons.name: Intermezzo of Crackling Sparks
Eidolons.description: The Dahlia's Talent can now trigger up to 2 times per attack.

Eidolons.name: Nocturne of Rising Cinders
Eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

Eidolons.name: Aria of Boundless Embers
Eidolons.description: When The Dahlia uses her Ultimate, all allies' SPD increases by 10% for 2 turn(s).

Eidolons.name: Overture of Eternal Flames
Eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

Eidolons.name: Finale of the Undying Pyre
Eidolons.description: The Dahlia's Ultimate additionally reduces all enemies' Break Effect RES by 20% for 2 turn(s).
